identificationModule.briefTitle: Assessing Use Of Mifepristone After Progestin Priming For Use As "Missed Period Pills"
identificationModule.officialTitle: Assessing Use Of Mifepristone After Progestin Priming For Use As "Missed Period Pills"

collaborators.name: Cuidado Integral de la Mujer, Gineclinic, S.C.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study will assess the effectiveness and acceptability of a 3-day missed period pill regimen.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Missed period pills (MPPs) are medications used for uterine evacuation among women with late menses who have not confirmed pregnancy status. Provision of MPPs could expand reproductive service options for individuals in a variety of settings. This study will collect data on the efficacy, safety, and acceptability of a 3-day missed period pill regimen among individuals with missed menses of 1-10 days

armGroups.label: Missed period pill regimen
armGroups.description: 1.5 mg levonorgestrel given on day 1 200 mg mifepristone given on day 3

interventions.name: Levonorgestrel
interventions.description: All participants receive 1.5 mg levonorgestrel on day 1

interventions.name: Mifepristone
interventions.description: All participants receive 200 mg mifepristone on day 3

primaryOutcomes.measure: Efficacy of missed period pill regimen
primaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of participants not pregnant at follow-up among those who were pregnant at enrollment
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 28 days after administration of levonorgestrel

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Effectiveness of missed period pill regimen
secondaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of all enrolled participants not pregnant at follow-up (among those who were and were not pregnant at enrollment)
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 28 days after administration of levonorgestrel

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Effectiveness at inducing return of menses within 10 days
secondaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of participants reporting return of missed menses within 10 days of initiating missed period pill regimen
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 10 days after administration of levonorgestrel

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Occurrence of treatment-emergent adverse events and/or side effects (safety and tolerability)
secondaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of participants who report adverse events and/or side effects
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 28 days after administration of levonorgestrel

secondaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of participants who report that the missed period pill service was acceptable or highly acceptable to them
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Up to 28 days after administration of levonorgestrel

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18-49 years
* General good health
* Does not want to be pregnant
* History of regular monthly menstrual cycles (±3 days)
* Missed menses of 1 to 10 days as verified by report of last menstrual period
* Sexual activity in the past month
* Willing and able to sign consent forms
* Willing to return for a follow-up visit
* Willing to provide a urine sample at enrollment and at follow-up

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known allergies or contraindications to mifepristone
* Symptoms of or risk factors for ectopic pregnancy, such as vaginal bleeding or spotting within the past week; unilateral pelvic pain or significant bilateral pelvic pain within the past week; prior ectopic pregnancy; prior permanent contraception or other tubal surgery
* Current use of an IUD, contraceptive implant or injectable
